big_case.notes: Execution-day shadow-docket vacatur of a circuit stay in a capital case with national coverage and a written three-Justice dissent: the human stakes are absolute and public attention was high, but the order is a routine application of Hill and Gonzalez, carries no majority writing, and settles no open legal question. High visibility, low doctrinal consequence.
